title: Fencing Review — A guide for parents and fencers

beats.label: welcome
beats.text: This guide follows seven tasks for a parent and fencer. We use fictional names and demo recordings.

beats.label: enter-fencer
beats.text: First, enter the fencer's name. Here, we use Alex Rivera.

beats.label: continue-setup
beats.text: Tap Continue to save the name. The app uses one fencer profile.

beats.label: new-tournament
beats.text: Tap the plus button to add a tournament.

beats.label: tournament-name
beats.text: Enter a tournament name. You can also set its date, location, and time zone.

beats.label: save-tournament
beats.text: Tap Save to create the tournament.

beats.label: tournament-ready
beats.text: The tournament is ready. Next, add its schedule or enter bouts yourself.

beats.label: import-schedule
beats.text: To use a schedule screenshot, tap Import Schedule.

beats.label: open-screenshot-photos
beats.text: Tap Select schedule screenshots. The app opens the Photos picker.

beats.label: select-screenshot
beats.text: Select the schedule screenshot. Make sure the names and table are clear.

beats.label: add-screenshot
beats.text: Tap Add to read the selected screenshot.

beats.label: review-schedule
beats.text: Scroll to the proposed bouts. Check opponents and bout numbers. Correct any mistakes before saving.

beats.label: confirm-schedule
beats.text: Tap Confirm Schedule when the details are correct. The app saves the confirmed bouts.

beats.label: schedule-ready
beats.text: The bout list now shows the imported schedule. The screenshot and proposed text stay on this device.

beats.label: manual-open
beats.text: You can also add a bout without a screenshot. Open Import Schedule again.

beats.label: manual-entry
beats.text: Tap Manual Entry.

beats.label: add-manual-bout
beats.text: Tap Add proposed bout to create an empty row.

beats.label: manual-opponent
beats.text: Enter the opponent's name. We will use Casey Jordan.

beats.label: manual-number
beats.text: Enter the bout number from the full bout order. Use a positive number that does not conflict with another bout.

beats.label: confirm-manual
beats.text: Check the new row, then tap Confirm Schedule.

beats.label: manual-ready
beats.text: The manual bout now appears beside the imported bouts.

beats.label: choose-bout
beats.text: Before importing videos, open the correct bout. Every selected recording will go into this bout.

beats.label: import-videos
beats.text: Tap Import Recordings to open the recording review screen.

beats.label: select-recordings
beats.text: Tap Select Recordings to open the Photos picker.

beats.label: select-video-one
beats.text: Select the first recording from this bout.

beats.label: select-video-two
beats.text: Select any other recordings from the same bout. Several recordings can belong to one bout.

beats.label: add-selected-videos
beats.text: Tap Add to load the selected recordings.

beats.label: allow-photos
beats.text: If your device asks, tap Allow Full Access so the app can read the selected recordings.

beats.label: review-video-import
beats.text: Check the import results. If one recording fails, you can still confirm the successful recordings.

beats.label: confirm-video-import
beats.text: Confirm the import to attach these recordings to the bout. The original videos stay unchanged in Photos.

beats.label: recordings-ready
beats.text: The recordings are now linked to this bout. The app orders them by recording time.

beats.label: open-editor
beats.text: Tap Review and Trim Recordings to open the editor.

beats.label: preview-original
beats.text: Tap Play to preview the selected original recording.

beats.label: pause-original
beats.text: Pause near a moment that you want to keep.

beats.label: show-trim-controls
beats.text: Scroll to Trim a review clip. These controls set the section that you will save.

beats.label: first-clip-start
beats.text: Move the Start slider to the beginning of the useful action.

beats.label: first-clip-end
beats.text: Move the End slider to the end of that action. Check the selected duration.

beats.label: save-first-clip
beats.text: Tap Save Clip. The app creates a separate edited movie and queues its upload.

beats.label: second-clip-start
beats.text: To save another moment from the same recording, move Start to the next useful action.

beats.label: second-clip-end
beats.text: Move End to finish the second selection.

beats.label: save-second-clip
beats.text: Tap Save Clip again. One original recording can produce several independent review clips.

beats.label: show-review-clips
beats.text: Scroll to Review Clips. Wait for Available before clearing an uploaded clip's local copy.

beats.label: favorite-first-clip
beats.text: Tap the star beside a clip to mark that clip as a favorite.

beats.label: clip-star-meaning
beats.text: A filled star means this clip is a favorite. Tap it again to remove the favorite mark.

beats.label: close-editor
beats.text: Tap Done to return to the bout details.

beats.label: bout-star-meaning
beats.text: The bout's star is an indicator. It fills when at least one clip in that bout is a favorite.

beats.label: open-clips-for-delete
beats.text: To delete a review clip, open Review and Trim Recordings again.

beats.label: find-clips-for-delete
beats.text: Scroll toward the review clip list.

beats.label: show-clips-for-delete
beats.text: Find the edited clip that you want to remove. Check its start and end times.

beats.label: delete-first-clip
beats.text: Tap Delete beside that clip.

beats.label: delete-warning
beats.text: Read the confirmation. Deleting removes the edited clip. It does not delete the original recording in Photos.

beats.label: confirm-clip-delete
beats.text: Tap Delete Clip to confirm. The app also removes the clip's cloud copy where applicable.

beats.label: one-clip-remains
beats.text: The other review clip remains. A cloud deletion that cannot finish immediately waits for recovery.

beats.label: close-after-delete
beats.text: Tap Done to return to the bout.

beats.label: bout-no-favorite
beats.text: We deleted the only favorite clip. The bout's star is now empty because no remaining clip is a favorite.

beats.label: close-bout
beats.text: Close the bout details to return to the tournament.

beats.label: open-fencer-settings
beats.text: Open Fencer to manage the profile and local clip storage.

beats.label: storage-counters
beats.text: Clip storage shows local exports and downloaded copies. These values describe device storage, not working memory.

beats.label: clear-local-copies
beats.text: Tap Clear Local Clip Copies to free storage on this device.

beats.label: storage-warning
beats.text: This clears uploaded local exports and downloaded copies across bouts. It keeps clips in iCloud and protects pending uploads.

beats.label: confirm-clear-copies
beats.text: Tap Clear Local Copies to confirm. The app reports how many files it removed.

beats.label: storage-result
beats.text: The local storage counts decrease. Saved cloud clips can download again when you play them with an available connection.

beats.label: finish
beats.text: Your original recordings remain in Photos. You can now organize bouts, save useful clips, and review them together.
